name: Markiplier Montage
summary: Markiplier Montage is a mod for Friday Night Funkin' based around the Five Nights at Freddy's as well as of course, Markiplier! We intend to give a unique experience with the mod, with a unique Youtube based UI as well as (hopefully) balanced quirky mechanics. The mod can be a bit difficult, but not too difficult (there won't be any insta death mechanics or anything). Every mainline song also is a recreation of the respective FNAF game the song is based in, so you won't just be playing a rhythm game here!
